description: Implementation-ready architecture SPECs, reviews, design decisions, optional planning profiles, and evidence-based project recovery.

defaultPrompt: Walk me through an implementation-ready architecture SPEC for this product idea
Review this architecture document and identify exact gaps and contradictions
Compare these approaches and recommend the simplest design that satisfies the requirements
interface.longDescription: Create implementation-ready architecture SPECs in Markdown, AsciiDoc, or an explicitly selected project format. Review real source and contracts, preserve capabilities through migrations, and make ownership and transition authority explicit. Record significant decisions in ADRs using existing conventions. When source artifacts and host tools are available, carry out authorized architecture-scoped implementation and preserve cumulative progress through self-contained handoffs. Specify pipeline recovery, end-to-end budgets, and AI component boundaries only where the product requires them. Keep requirements, tasks, acceptance, and evidence aligned without imposing a stack, research framework, or unnecessary documentation. Select an epic, milestone, or roadmap profile without generating an automatic document bundle. Assess damaged projects read-only, preserving valid improvements; execute recovery only when authorized. Use focused CLI contract guidance when designing command-line interfaces.

name: system-architect
